meta.title: Alsi Finance — every receipt, statement and swipe, reconciled
meta.description: Photograph receipts, drop in PDF statements and spreadsheet exports, or link a US bank account. Alsi reads them, you confirm what lands, and an analyst that has seen all of it explains the rest. Now in closed beta.

hero.formula: income − recurring − EMIs − card minimums − spend
hero.lede: A shoebox of paper goes in. Alsi reads it under one lamp, you approve it, and nothing else moves.
hero.scrollHint: Scroll — the paper does the talking

capture.label: 01 — Capture
capture.heading: Everything goes under the same lamp.
capture.body: A receipt is a photo. A statement is forty pages. A card alert is one line of SMS. They all queue up, pass the reader once, and come out printed as rows — merchant, date, tax, total.
capture.foot: No format to learn · no spreadsheet to keep

sources.label: Sources
sources.heading: Eight ways in. One shape out.

receipt.title: Receipt photo
receipt.body: Snap it at the counter. Merchant, date, tax and total come off the paper.

statement.title: PDF statement
statement.body: Chase, Amex, HDFC. Every page parsed, every row matched to an account.

csv.title: Spreadsheet export
csv.body: CSV or XLSX, whatever your bank gives you. Columns get mapped once, then remembered.

sms.title: Bank SMS
sms.body: Forward and forget. Card alerts become rows before you get home.

bank.title: Bank link
bank.body: US accounts through Plaid. Balances and transactions re-sync every six hours.

paystub.title: Paystub
paystub.body: Gross, deductions, net — so income is a fact and not an estimate.

loan.title: Loan schedule
loan.body: Principal and interest split for every month still ahead of you.

fx.title: FX receipt
fx.body: Converted at the day's rate, with both sides of the trade kept.

confirm.label: 02 — Confirm
confirm.heading: Nothing is filed until you stamp it.
confirm.body: Every read is a proposal, not a fact. Most pass in a glance. The ones Alsi isn't sure about wait in amber until you look — and once you correct a merchant, it never asks about that merchant again.

ledger.label: The ledger
ledger.heading: One row per event, and the paper it came from.

understand.label: 03 — Understand
understand.heading: The pile, finally shaped like a year.
understand.body: Twelve stacks of evidence, one line across the top. Ask it anything in plain language — every answer comes back with the rows it was drawn from, and nothing invented in between.
understand.question: “Why was June heavy?”
understand.answer: → Marriott 412.00 + Delta 388.10, both Travel, both new.

ledger.body: Everything in, one reviewed ledger out — normalised across currencies and accounts.

analyst.body: Ask in plain language, get an answer drawn only from your own file.

debt.body: A payoff order, with the interest each choice costs you shown in full.

roadmap.title: Roadmap — Alsi Finance
roadmap.heading: What's in the beta, and what isn't.
roadmap.lede: Beta accounts get the whole product, not a cut-down tier. Here is what that means today, and what is still being built. The README in the repository keeps the authoritative list.
roadmap.s1: Receipt photos, PDF statements, CSV and XLSX exports, and forwarded bank SMS, all read into a review queue you approve.
roadmap.s2: US bank, card and loan accounts through Plaid, re-syncing every six hours, plus manual sync on demand.
roadmap.s3: The analyst, across your transactions, debts and documents, with sources attached and a memory store you can review and delete from.
roadmap.s4: Budgets, categories, recurring series and rules that stick once you've corrected them.
roadmap.s5: Debt payoff planning across cards and loans, with the interest each ordering costs you.
roadmap.s6: TOTP two-factor with one-time recovery codes, AES-256-GCM document encryption, and full data export.
roadmap.l1: Gmail ingestion. The endpoint is switched off and returns 410.
roadmap.l2: Web push delivery. The preference saves, but nothing is sent — in-app and email notifications do work.
roadmap.l3: WebAuthn passkeys. TOTP two-factor is what exists today.
roadmap.l4: Shared workspaces. Alsi is one account, one workspace, by design for now.
roadmap.foot: Something here a deal-breaker for you?
